market.worldSizeUSD_B_range: Estimates vary sharply by scope: global ethnic wear ~$89-96B (2025) per most sources, with one outlier estimate as high as $150B; CAGR estimates range ~6.4-8.3%. India specifically: $21.5B (2025) to $32.7B by 2032 (~6.17%/yr) per one source; another cites $26.9B by FY26 at ~10.6%/yr — a wide spread reflecting differing category definitions.
globalCompetitors: not applicable at a global scale — this is a domestically-anchored category; see peers[] for Indian comparables
market.domesticSlice: Women account for ~70% of the India ethnic wear market; ethnic wear makes up ~67% of the average Indian woman's wardrobe. International online ethnic apparel (diaspora e-commerce) is a smaller ~$2B market growing 25-30%/yr.

structureFacts: Rising disposable income and expanding wedding/festive spending are the primary demand drivers for branded ethnic wear
Growing organized-retail penetration and rapid e-commerce/D2C adoption are structural growth drivers sector-wide
Festive/wedding-season seasonality (Diwali, Eid, wedding season) is a recurring demand driver in both domestic and diaspora export markets
India's diaspora is estimated at ~35.4 million globally (15.85M NRIs + 19.57M PIOs) — the demand base for diaspora-market ethnic wear exports

adoptionStructure.note: Not a repurchase-rate category like seeds; demand follows disposable income growth, wedding/festival seasonality, and fashion-cycle refresh rate rather than a structural forced-repurchase mechanism

drivers: design/fashion trend cadence and frequency of new designs
price/value positioning across tiers (mid-market vs. premium/occasion-wear vs. mass artisanal)
fabric quality and occasion-appropriateness (festive, daily, bridal)
customerValue.strongestPredictor: not established from available research — design freshness and brand positioning both surfaced as relevant, no single strongest predictor identified

steps: design product breadth (sarees, kurta sets, lehengas, kurtis, fusion, festive/bridal)
extend into adjacent categories (e.g. men's ethnic wear)
in-house design studio generating high design-refresh rate
plan production against seasonal/festival demand peaks
operate exclusive brand outlets (omnichannel with online)
demand arises (festival/wedding season or everyday wear need)
